name: Update Interview Learning Doc
description: After a service, agent, core, or storage file is edited, prompt Kiro to update docs/learning/INTERVIEW_LEARNING.md with a new or updated feature entry covering all 10 sections.

then.prompt: A source file was just edited. Inspect the change and update docs/learning/INTERVIEW_LEARNING.md with a new or updated entry for the affected feature. Use the standard 10-section entry format defined in that file: (1) Simple Explanation, (2) Technical Explanation, (3) Why It Matters, (4) Interview Short Answer, (5) Interview Deep-Dive Answer, (6) Business Explanation, (7) Real Example From AgentMesh, (8) Trade-offs, (9) Follow-up Questions, (10) Resume Bullet. Keep the tone practical, production-focused, and useful for both technical interviews and recruiter conversations.
